description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

 

We’re seeking a highly motivated GTM Lead, Ecommerce to bring Liftoff’s newest advertising product to market. Our solution drives app users to purchase directly on merchants’ ecommerce sites. As our first dedicated ecommerce hire, you’ll own sales end to end while simultaneously building the go-to-market playbook. This is a high impact, quota carrying role ideal for a senior seller who works independently, thrives in ambiguity, and is energized by developing a new line of business inside an established organization.

Responsibilities

  • Build our ecommerce GTM framework: define targeting strategy, test and refine Liftoff’s ideal customer profile, and develop a repeatable, scalable sales motion.
  • Own the full sales cycle for Liftoff’s ecommerce offering: discovery, proposal development, contract negotiation, and campaign launch.

Develop the agency channel - identify and manage ongoing relationships with performance marketing shops representing key ecommerce brands. 

  • Design and test financial incentive structures that accelerate new advertiser onboarding.  
  • Represent Liftoff and establish our ongoing presence at key ecommerce conferences. 
  • Identify third-party tech partners to implement industry standard measurement and attribution models.
  • Serve as the voice of the ecommerce market internally. This is a highly cross functional role that will require close collaboration with marketing, product, operations, creative, finance, and legal. 
  • Independently use data and analytics to diagnose performance gaps and deliver recommendations that drive client outcomes; maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting in CRM.

What Sets You Apart

  • 10+ years in performance advertising sales; demonstrated experience selling to ecommerce / Shopify brands strongly preferred.
  • An established network of decision makers at DTC brands and adjacent agencies, with a proven ability to convert relationships into revenue.
  • Expert fluency in the ecommerce adtech ecosystem, including leading incrementality, attribution, and MTA platforms. 
  • Builder mindset: works independently under general direction while embracing ‘test and learn’ mentality. Ability to pivot strategy quickly based on market feedback.
  • Track record of closing high value new logos and scaling them into durable ‘always on’ revenue.
  • Strong analytical depth: able to synthesize multiple data sources into strong client facing and internal facing recommendations. 
  • Outstanding presentation, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to diverse and senior stakeholders.
  • Relentlessly driven and professionally persistent - able to overcome objections, navigate complex sales cycles, and turn a "no" into a "yes."

Location:

This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities: CA, CO, ID, IL, FL, GA, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, TX, UT, and WA

We are a remote-first company with US hubs in Redwood City, Los Angeles, and New York City.

Travel Expectations:

As part of our go-to-market strategy, the sales team is expected to attend key industry events and conferences to deepen relationships with advertisers clients, stay informed on market trends, and maximize visibility within the ecosystem. In addition to external engagement, Liftoff holds company-wide events, regional team meetings, and offsites, creating valuable opportunities for cross-functional collaboration, strategic planning, and team building.

Compensation:

Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Base compensation will vary based on the candidate's location and experience.  

The following are our total cash compensation (TCC) ranges for this role: 

  • SF Bay Area, Los Angeles/Orange County, Seattle, NYC: $265,000 - $375,00
  • Olympia, Austin, San Diego, Santa Barbara, Boston: $243,000 - $345,000 
  • All other cities and towns in our approved states: $227,000 - $322,000

Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. We’re shaping the future of the mobile app ecosystem—join us and help accelerate what’s next.

 

Liftoff’s compensation strategy includes competitive salaries, equity, and benefits designed to support employee well-being and performance. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Benefits may include medical coverage, wellness stipends, and additional perks based on your country of residence.

 

Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Agency and Third Party Recruiter Notice:

Liftoff does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team. All candidates must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System by approved Liftoff vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Recruiting Team for a specific job opening. No placement fees will be paid to any firm unless such a request has been made by the Liftoff Recruiting Team and such a candidate was submitted to the Liftoff Recruiting Team via our Applicant Tracking System.
